L24n1389.name: Split-word pieces → missing/NULL
L24n1389.description: Fires on a word-internal fragment that continues a split word, e.g. 'im|put|es' in imputes, 'rem|oves' in removes, 'bl|azes', and on 'Click' in web boilerplate; pushes toward NULL/NA and 'missing' tokens.

L22n1354.name: Colon before a URL
L22n1354.description: Fires on the colon that introduces a web address ('the link:', 'visit:', 'See:', 'Facebook:') and on the 'https'/'http' token right after it; pushes toward writing 'http://www' addresses.

L23n1048.name: Program-spec connectives → print
L23n1048.description: Fires on 'and', 'then', 'should' in chat requests that describe a program ('the program should', 'calculates and', 'then sorts'), the word just before the expected action; pushes toward 'print'/'output' tokens.

L23n694.name: Outcome-display verbs → result
L23n694.description: Fires on the word just before an object describing a measured or shown outcome ('affect [the] result', 'interpreting [these] graphs', 'displays [the] answer', 'outputs [the] determinant'); pushes toward 'result(s)'.

L21n842.name: Measurement abbreviations → value
L21n842.description: Fires on the abbreviation or symbol of a scientific or clinical measure ('MIC' in 'above the MIC', 'LD' in 'LD50', 'FR' in 'eGFR', 'K' in 'pKa', 'A1C'), mostly its later pieces; pushes toward 'value(s)'.

L22n720.name: Word before 'value(s)'
L22n720.description: Fires on the word that sets up a value or parameter noun in how-to text: 'any' in 'accept any fractional values', 'missing' in 'missing values', 'a' in 'simulate a value', 'column' in 'return column'; pushes toward 'value' tokens.

L23n597.name: Counting words → counter
L23n597.description: Fires on 'running' in 'a running total', 'loop', 'integer', '(int' in C signatures, and on random word pieces like 'retro' in retroviruses and 'C' in 'Cited'; pushes toward 'count'/'counter' tokens.

L24n2517.name: Tracking identifiers → IP
L24n2517.description: Fires on conjunctions and modifiers inside lists of network or personal identifiers ('IP address, or network location', 'device IDs,', 'browsing', 'GPS', 'Internet'), and on sudo/root shell-prompt tokens like ']$' and '#'; pushes toward 'IP'.

L22n996.name: 'and' before output verb
L22n996.description: Fires on 'and' (also 'as', 'the') in program specs like 'takes X and outputs Y', on the word just before the output verb; pushes toward 'output' tokens.

L22n1973.name: Split-name fragments → brace
L22n1973.description: Fires on the second or third piece of a name or word split into tokens ('Hal|le', 'Brig|adier', 'Leib|n|iz', 'Leeu|wen|hoek') and on '<' in '#include <' and '=' in 'x<=0'; pushes toward an opening curly brace '{'.

L24n203.name: Mid-word fragments → underscore
L24n203.description: Fires on a fragment that continues a word or identifier split across tokens ('rev|istas', 'stat|uary', 'Stony|brook', 'mitted', 'concerned-parent'); pushes toward underscore-joined identifiers like '_r' or '_h'.

L24n989.name: Proper-noun opener → brace
L24n989.description: Fires on the short first fragment of a capitalized proper noun split into tokens ('Al' in Almohad, Alamo, Almazaras; 'Nan' in Nanaimo; 'Cr' in Crataegus; 'Pall' in Pallene; 'Mal'); pushes toward an opening brace '{'.

L23n1385.name: Hash-table bucket/key terms
L23n1385.description: Fires on hash-table and lookup words ('bucket', 'keys', 'stored', 'row', 'hash') and on the word just before the looked-up item ('an identifier', 'the position'); pushes toward 'key'/'Key' tokens.

L22n2374.name: Programming-language names → code
L22n2374.description: Fires on programming-language and markup names ('Pascal', 'HTML', 'Java', 'Python', 'Matlab', 'SQL', 'CSS') and on 'pseudo' in 'pseudocode'; also on the 'of' in 'a piece of text' prompts; pushes toward the word 'code'.

L24n1635.name: Lead-in comma → check
L24n1635.description: Fires on the comma, colon or question mark that ends a lead-in like 'To learn more about X,', 'For more details,', 'Want to know more about COVID-19?', right before a 'visit/see/check' pointer; pushes toward 'check'.

L24n1513.name: Chris and scattered fragments
L24n1513.description: Fires on the first name 'Chris' (Governor Chris Christie, Attorney General Chris Carr) and on scattered word-start fragments ('alt' in altcoins, opening quote marks, 'Windows'); the push toward '+'-prefixed tokens shows no clear effect when steered.

L23n2181.name: Addendum markers → edit
L23n2181.description: Fires on the word that opens an addendum to a post: 'Follow' (Follow Math Help Forum, follow-up question), 'EDIT', 'UPDATE', 'Latest', 'Below'; pushes toward 'edit' tokens.

L22n571.name: Method names before '()'
L22n571.description: Fires on the name of a function or method in prose code references ('seek' in seek(), '.head' in dataset.head(5), 'readline'); pushes toward '()' call parentheses.

L22n1955.name: Outcome adjectives → result
L22n1955.description: Fires on the adjective or verb just before an outcome noun: 'disastrous' (effects), 'reach' (conclusions), 'achieve' (a successful outcome), 'accurate', 'desired', 'fatal', 'definite'; pushes toward 'result(s)'.

L24n3029.name: Host names → domain
L24n3029.description: Fires on web host and domain names and the words near them ('.com' in example.com, '@example', 'Etsy', 'AWS', 'Amazon', 'Chrome', 'HTTPS certificates'); pushes toward 'domain' tokens.

L24n2673.name: Travel, flight, route words
L24n2673.description: Fires on motion and travel words such as 'migration', 'flight', 'fly', 'flying', 'along' (as in 'along the way') and 'tracing' in orbit and route text, mostly on the word itself. Pushes the model to write 'path', 'Path' and '_path' tokens.

L0n38.name: Abstract social-state nouns
L0n38.description: Fires on the head noun of an abstract social or medical condition, right after 'call for', 'the new', 'the problem with' or 'a', e.g. 'equality', 'norm', 'problem', 'epidemic', 'constant', 'migraine'. Also fires on the '</think>' closing tag. Pushing it up writes code closers, but steered output is only newlines.

L24n1154.name: Graph/illustration setup words
L24n1154.description: Negative on the word that sets up a graph, plot or illustration: 'your' before 'graph', 'a' before 'link graph', 'can' before 'find the parent graph', and 'illustrate' or 'illustrated'. The peak is on the setup word, not on 'graph' itself. Pushing it negative writes 'graph'.

L24n1762.name: Rank and level ordinals
L24n1762.description: Negative on rank and level words: 'higher', 'highest', 'high' (high school, high-quality), 'first', 'second', 'third', 'sixth'. The peak is on the word itself, e.g. 'second-order', 'higher cognitive', 'first grade'. Pushing it negative writes 'order' repeatedly.

L13n3041.name: Task-prompt quality adjectives
L13n3041.description: Negative on the quality or criterion word in a writing request, the trait the piece should show: 'practical', 'ease' (of use), 'playful', 'variety', 'reliability', 'persuasive', 'intuitive', 'visuals', 'convenience'. Pushing it negative writes no clear token, only asterisk spam.

L24n1449.name: Opposite words, name fragments
L24n1449.description: Fires on 'opposite' and 'opposing' (opposite polarity). It also fires on odd fragments inside names: the 'ø' in Jørgensen, 'Carl', 'Charles', 'Cart' in Carte du Ciel. Pushes toward 'sign' and 'signs'. The name part is unrelated to the opposition part.

L24n654.name: Web boilerplate, catalog labels
L24n654.description: Fires on the label word in web boilerplate and catalog fields: 'PDF', 'Download', 'Copyright', 'https', 'Location', 'Publication Series', 'LC Control Number', and 'Image' in 'Image via'. Pushes toward 'address', 'URL' and 'number', and steered output becomes 'number number' spam. The reading is boilerplate, but the writing does not match it.

L24n2620.name: Browser/extension software nouns
L24n2620.description: Negative on software-app nouns, mainly 'Chrome' (Chrome extension, Chrome page), 'browser', 'Firefox', 'Reader', 'Edge', plus 'install' before a plugin or package. Pushing it negative writes 'extension' over and over.

L23n1647.name: Mid-word fragments, C types
L23n1647.description: Fires on the first or middle piece of a rare word split into several tokens: 'op' in 'leopards', 'app' in 'lappaceum', 'Cr' in 'Crataegus', 'ios' in 'Cardiospermum'. Pushes toward C and C++ type keywords such as 'int', 'bool', 'void', 'uint' and 'char'.

L23n455.name: Quantity qualifier before 'number'
L23n455.description: Negative on the word that sets up a count or quantity, mostly right before 'number of': 'average', 'total', 'actual', 'exact', 'largest', and 'the' in 'the number of'. Pushing it negative writes 'number' repeatedly.

L23n2810.name: Before detect or diagnose
L23n2810.description: Fires on the modal, adverb or adjective just before a verb of detection, diagnosis or help: 'early' (early detection), 'reliably' (reliably detect), 'can' and 'be' in 'can help' or 'be diagnosed', 'error' before correction. Pushes toward 'detect', 'detection' and 'catch'.

L24n1809.name: Size and life-stage facts
L24n1809.description: Negative on the word before a size, weight or life-stage fact in natural-history and product text: 'can' before 'grow up to' or 'live up to', 'females' before 'are smaller', 'the' before 'size', 'weigh', 'which' before a description. Pushing it negative writes 'measure' repeatedly.

L24n1261.name: Log/reference book nouns
L24n1261.description: Fires on the noun naming a written record or reference book: 'journal' (journal entry), 'diary', 'dictionary', 'routing' (routing table), 'bibliography', 'Cited' in a works-cited list. Pushes toward 'entry' and 'entries'.

L22n2096.name: Property and effect adjectives
L22n2096.description: Fires on the adjective that introduces a property or effect of a substance or thing: 'anti-inflammatory', 'antioxidant', 'physical' (physical properties), 'cooling' (cooling effect), 'cleansing', 'beneficial', 'possesses', 'desirable' (traits). Pushes toward 'property' and 'properties'.

L24n1265.name: Birth-death dates and dashes
L24n1265.description: Negative on digits and the dash inside birth-death date ranges and year spans, e.g. the '8' in 'June 1236' and the '–' in '(1260–1279)'. Also fires on IPA symbols such as 'ˈ'. Pushing it negative writes question marks.

L22n1337.name: Contrast pairs and vs
L22n1337.description: Fires on the second party of a contrast or case-name pair: 'Jones' in 'Jones I/II', 'Virginia' in 'West Virginia State Board', and the number or unit that ends a comparison ('57%' vs 36%, '2.5 minutes' compared to Bitcoin's 10). Pushes toward 'vs', 'versus' and 'compared'.

L24n2863.name: Absence and loss words
L24n2863.description: Negative on 'Without' and 'lacks', on 'lost' in 'lost wetlands', and on word fragments in chemical or proper names: the 'ral' in sucralose, 'ampo' in shampoos, 'chen' in Schenckenschans. Pushing it negative writes 'loss', 'lose' and 'losing'. The loss reading is coherent, but the fragments are not.

L23n1239.name: How-to technique nouns
L23n1239.description: Negative on the gerund or noun naming a practice or technique in how-to text: 'folding' (folding techniques), 'farming' (farming practices), 'teaching', 'delivery', 'stitching', 'brushing' and flossing, 'learning' (learning styles). Pushing it negative writes 'method' repeatedly.

L24n341.name: Data fields and records
L24n341.description: Negative on verbs and determiners that introduce records or fields in data-processing text: 'retrieves', 'extracts', 'the following' before a field list, 'each' before a record, and 'with' in 'a database with three tables'. Pushing it negative writes 'field' and 'fields'.

L23n1007.name: Word-initial subword pieces
L23n1007.description: Negative on the first piece of a word split into several tokens, mostly a capitalised name or rare word start: 'Wol' in Wolpertinger, 'Kos' in Kosrae, 'sol' in solstice, 'Det' in Detrick, 'Fol' in Folio, 'Iron' in Iron Lady. Pushing it negative writes 'input' repeatedly.

L24n361.name: Mid-word fragments, mixed
L24n361.description: Fires on a mid-word subword piece of a rare name or word (Bam|ako, Aver|roes, Sand|boxes, Math|ews, Tigr|is), and on 'and' after 'calculates' or 'be' after 'must' in coding and task prompts. Pushes toward 'round' and 'Round' tokens.

L22n2990.name: Values and ethics words
L22n2990.description: Fires on words for values or ethics ('moral', 'principles', 'ideals', 'ethical') and on the possessive 's or 'and' right before 'mission' or 'values' in company and ethics text. Pushes toward 'values'.

L22n203.name: Single-letter math symbols
L22n203.description: Fires on a lone capital letter or Greek or math symbol used as a variable or abbreviation (R in R(t), H in HPC, G in GDP, γ, x′, n in 'is an integer'). Pushes toward prime and apostrophe marks (′, ’).

L22n1968.name: Study findings lead-ins
L22n1968.description: Goes strongly negative on the determiner or possessive before a research noun in science-news text ('the study's findings', 'these results', 'their findings', 'new study'). Pushes toward 'results' and 'findings'.

L24n1170.name: Temperature min/max modifiers
L24n1170.description: Goes strongly negative on a modifier before a climate or extreme-value statistic ('annual average temperature', 'global temperature', 'monthly' tornado activity, 'lowest'). Pushes toward 'min' and 'minimum'.

L23n1746.name: Web page and frontend
L23n1746.description: Goes negative on words in web-page, layout and frontend text ('page', 'Scroll', 'Canvas Can be', 'slow' performance, 'React' and 'Vue' names). Few shared points beyond web/UI context. Pushes toward 'load' and 'loaded'.

L24n2010.name: Standard style and conventions
L24n2010.description: Fires on the word right before 'style', 'schemes', 'conventions' or 'system' in standards and how-to text ('citation [style]', 'consistent [color] schemes', 'astronomical [naming] conventions'). Pushes toward 'uniform' and 'consistent'.

L24n2816.name: Modifier before system
L24n2816.description: Fires on the modifier right before 'system', mainly 'solar' in 'solar system' and 'solar wind', also 'root', 'ring', 'school' and 'star'. Pushes toward 'system' and 'systems'.

L23n3068.name: Modifier before facility nouns
L23n3068.description: Fires on the word just before a facility or office noun ('recycling [transfer] station', 'sewage [treatment] plant', 'Visitor [Center]', 'Recreation [Department]'). Pushes toward 'center' and 'centre'.

L24n2008.name: Sort order and reversal
L24n2008.description: Fires on 'in' before 'ascending' or 'descending order' and on 'ASC|DESC', plus reversal words ('backwards', 'inverse', 'vice versa', 'inversely'). Pushes toward 'reverse', 'inverse' and 'reversed'.

L24n2438.name: Efficiency and cost words
L24n2438.description: Goes strongly negative on the word just before an efficiency word ('energy-[use] efficiency', 'cost [effective]', 'more [efficient]') and on 'fuel' in 'fuel consumption'. Pushes toward 'efficient' and 'efficiency' forms.

L23n1946.name: 'Look' and lookup verbs
L23n1946.description: Goes strongly negative on 'look', 'looking', 'looked' and 'lookup' ('2D lookups', 'look up', 'look at', 'look for'), including non-table uses. Pushes toward 'table' and 'tables'.

L22n3055.name: 'Have' in AI disclaimers
L22n3055.description: Goes strongly negative on 'have' right after 'I do not' or 'I don't' in AI-limitation answers ('I do not [have] access to', 'I don't [have] any live'). Pushes toward 'access'.

L22n783.name: Form input validation words
L22n783.description: Goes strongly negative on form and input words in web-form and validation prompts ('input [fields]', 'HTML [form]', 'validate' in validateEmail, 'input validation'). Pushes toward 'validate' and 'validation'.

L24n2038.name: Official issuing verbs
L24n2038.description: Goes strongly negative on the verb after an official actor: 'issued' (proclamation, apology, guidelines), 'signed', 'passes', 'ordered', 'given'. Pushes toward 'order' and 'orders'.

L24n1518.name: Spending effort and resources
L24n1518.description: Goes strongly negative on 'of' after 'amount', 'lot' or 'a little bit', and on spend, focus or devote words before a resource or effort noun ('amount of resources', 'devote their energies', 'spend a lot of time'). Pushes toward 'energy' and 'resource'.

L2n695.name: Diffuse ogenic and unknown
L2n695.description: Diffuse: goes negative on the suffix 'ogenic' (anthrop|ogenic, path|ogenic), on 'unknown' in target or contact contexts, and on 'of' after 'goal' or 'aim'. Steering gives 'virus', 'V' and 'Vm', so the write side is unclear.

L23n1499.name: Software library name context
L23n1499.description: Goes strongly negative on the word just before, or on, a software library or framework name ('Core [Location] framework', 'Apache [Commons] Lang', 'Python [standard] library', 'WiringPi is [a] library'). Pushes toward 'library' and 'libraries'.

L23n978.name: Indefinite a/an before nouns
L23n978.description: Fires on indefinite 'a' or 'an' before a countable noun in technical how-to text ('stored in [a] number of buckets', 'creates [an] array', 'a sorting algorithm'), and on 'memory'. Pushes toward 'temp' and 'temporary'.

L23n1909.name: Split names, indefinite a
L23n1909.description: Fires on the second word-piece of a split name (Eun|ice, Har|vard, Hux|leyi, Ion|escu, Ep|s) and on 'a' before 'definite', 'common' or 'second' nouns. Pushes toward 'unique' and 'Unique'.

L24n2608.name: file-noun and 'sar' pieces
L24n2608.description: Fires on the noun 'file' or 'filename' where a file name or format is being named (e.g. 'upload a file', 'filenames'), and on word pieces like 'sar' inside 'sarcoma'; pushes toward 'extension(s)' next, and steered text spams 'extension'.

L22n1856.name: 'basic'/'small' before 'unit'
L22n1856.description: Fires on size or basis modifiers ('basic', 'small', 'smaller', 'smallest', 'structural', 'molecular') right before a noun for a unit or piece ('basic unit', 'smaller increments'); pushes toward 'unit(s)' next, and steered text spams 'unit'.

L22n2217.name: SQL clause → SELECT
L22n2217.description: Fires in SQL syntax text on tokens just before a clause keyword or inside a clause list: '[' before HAVING, a line break before ORDER BY, and 'of', 'in', 'to' in SQL docs; pushes toward 'select' next, and steered text drifts to 'select' words.

L20n1691.name: contrast/hedge slot to often
L20n1691.description: Fires on contrast or qualifier words ('but', 'Yet', 'Conversely', 'Indeed') and on the noun just before a hedged claim ('screen time', 'fresh water', 'new activities'); pushes toward frequency or hedge adverbs ('often', 'sometimes', 'usually', 'maybe'), and steered text spams 'often' and 'sometimes'.

L24n373.name: slot before bare verb
L24n373.description: Fires on the word right before a bare main verb: infinitive 'to' ('to identify', 'to fully understand') and adverbs or negation between an auxiliary and its verb ('do not want', 'also suggested', 'should be'); pushes toward 'capture/capturing', and steered text spams 'capturing'.

L23n643.name: slot before 'elements/features'
L23n643.description: Fires on adjectives and verbs like 'essential', 'key', 'structural', 'distinctive', 'incorporating', and on 'these' or 'certain', right before a noun for parts or features ('essential element', 'key aspects'); pushes toward 'element(s)', and steered text spams 'elements'.

L23n1384.name: copula/'the' before 'key'
L23n1384.description: Fires on 'is', the 's' of 'what's', or a sentence-opening 'The' right after a subject ('Knowing is', 'What is more', 'Understanding the cause is'), where a predicate like 'the key' or 'the first step' follows; pushes toward 'key', and steered text spams 'key'.

L24n777.name: punctuation before closing quote
L24n777.description: Fires on sentence or clause punctuation ('.', ',', '?', '...') that sits inside or right before a closing quote or parenthesis (e.g. 'now.”' or 'sentences.' inside parentheses); pushes toward closing-quote and close-paren tokens such as '.”' and ').'.

L24n2037.name: relative time modifiers
L24n2037.description: Fires on relative-time words 'last', 'next', 'every', 'yesterday', 'tomorrow' at the start of a time phrase ('last year', 'next October', 'every year'); pushes toward a time-unit noun next ('year', 'month', 'week', 'night'), and steered text spams 'night'.

L24n2971.name: Digits in ratios/percents
L24n2971.description: Fires on digits inside ratios and percents ('1:1', '70%', '25%', '3/4', '1,380,000' scales), strongest on the digit that completes the value; pushes toward a colon, as in ratios, and steered text spams ':'.

L23n821.name: leading digit of numbers
L23n821.description: Fires on the first digit of multi-digit numbers (the '2' in '20', '2,000', '29 million', '2 BCE') and on commas after a word; pushes toward '&', so steered text drifts into HTML entities like '&', a mismatch with what it reads.

L20n1620.name: question end to blank
L20n1620.description: Fires on the '?' that ends a question or instruction ('Why is blue light bad for the eyes?'), and on ':' or '.' ending a prompt line before an answer; pushes toward '_' blank tokens, and steered text spams underscores.

L23n724.name: word before 'method(s)'
L23n724.description: Fires on the first word of a compound noun or 'X options' phrase, such as 'payment' in 'payment methods', 'login' in 'loginname', 'access' in 'access code', 'birth' in 'birth control'; pushes toward 'method(s)' next, and steered text spams 'method'.

L24n2059.name: operation verbs before 'element'
L24n2059.description: Fires on arithmetic or operation verbs and word starts ('multiply', 'subtract', 'outputs', 'mul-', 'eigen-vectors', 'concatenates them') where an array or vector element is about to come; pushes toward 'element', and steered text spams 'element'.

L21n1480.name: slot before failure/error
L21n1480.description: Fires on 'from', 'of', or 'to' right after a verb or adjective of learning, fearing, or overcoming ('learn from', 'fear of', 'afraid to'), and on 'overcoming' or 'afraid' themselves, before a noun about mistakes or obstacles; pushes toward 'error' and 'failure', and steered text spams 'failure'.

L24n2179.name: digits in years, credentials
L24n2179.description: Fires on digits inside historical years and dates (the '0' or '4' in '270 AD', '640 BC', '1143') and on the comma or 'MD'/'DO' after a person's name; pushes toward capital era or credential tokens like 'AD', 'CB', 'CS', and steered text stays mostly normal.

L22n1188.name: genre or format label
L22n1188.description: Fires on the word just before a genre, style, or format noun ('op-ed', 'ballad', 'noir' in 'noir style', 'thriller', 'social media post', 'scientific paper'); pushes toward 'type' or 'kind', and steered text spams 'type of'.

L24n2749.name: article before shape noun
L24n2749.description: Fires on 'a', 'right', or 'is' and word pieces right before a geometric shape noun ('a triangle', 'right triangle', 'isosceles', 'trapezoid', 'frustum') in math or code prompts; pushes toward 'triangle(s)', and steered text mentions triangles.

L23n221.name: comma closing intro clause
L23n221.description: Fires on commas, most on a comma that closes an introductory or conditional clause ('IF YOU CHECKED MORE THAN HALF OF THE ABOVE,'), and on thousands separators ('1,900', '100,000'); pushes toward 'then', 'thus', 'therefore', and steered text spams 'then'.

L24n1186.name: placement verb before 'where'
L24n1186.description: Fires on verbs and adverbs of placing, going, or occurring ('starts', 'placed', 'found', 'go', 'going', 'every', 'all') just before a location or time complement ('placed before', 'found anywhere', 'going on'); pushes toward 'where', and steered text spams 'where'.

L14n92.name: Post-verb complement word
L14n92.description: Diffuse, low-level: fires on the word right after a verb or preposition that opens an object or complement, e.g. 'to' in 'link to', 'just' in 'skip just', 'up' in 'looked up', 'us' in 'for us', plus the piece of a split word such as 'ate' in oxygenate. Pushes toward mid-word fragments like 'lectic' and 'reshold'.

L14n2251.name: Topic adjective before noun
L14n2251.description: Fires (negative) on the adjective or topic modifier right before a noun in a request or generated title: 'Smart' in 'Smart Home', 'renewable' in 'renewable energy', 'classic' in 'classic chicken', 'wireless' in 'wireless touch screen', 'new' in 'new software'. Pushes toward adjective-ending fragments like 'ancial', 'oretical', 'ificant'.

L14n1811.name: Referent word in answers
L14n1811.description: Fires (negative) on the noun or header word that names the thing being asked about or written: 'song' in 'which specific song', 'film' in 'which film', 'Best' in 'Best Actor', 'Subject' as an email header, 'Ingredients' as a recipe header. Pushes toward word fragments like 'apore' and 'reshold'.

L0n9.name: Closing think-tag delimiter
L0n9.description: Fires on the '</think>' token that closes the empty reasoning block at the start of a chat-format assistant reply, peaking on that tag with little elsewhere. Pushes toward closing parentheses such as the fullwidth one and ')', and spams them.

L24n2097.name: Last digit before percent
L24n2097.description: Fires (negative) on the final digit of a number that is about to take '%' or 'percent', peaking on the '0' in '100%' or '50 per cent' and on the '9' in '99%', not on the % sign itself. Pushes toward the '%' token, and spams it.

L14n2233.name: Opening of explanatory gloss
L14n2233.description: Fires (negative) on the '(' or 'means' or 'change' that opens an explanation of the term just before it: 'VSDs (' before 'also commonly referred to', 'TPR (' before 'temperature', 'arribadas (' before 'arrival', 'which means' before 'strike'. Pushes toward noisy word fragments like 'sai', 'gibi', 'errors'.

L24n248.name: Capital letter starting name
L24n248.description: Fires on the capital letter that begins a proper name mid-sentence, peaking on that single initial before the rest of the name is written: the 'M' in 'Macclesfield', 'N' in 'Natan', 'S' in 'Saphari', 'D' in 'D J Garland'. Pushes toward a name, e.g. steering produced 'Emma'.

L11n9.name: Split-word final piece
L11n9.description: Fires (negative) on the last subword piece that completes a word or name split across tokens, mostly surnames and acronyms: 'man' in Schiff|man, 'oks' in Estabr|ooks, 'ik' in Høiv|ik, 'I' in RGG|I, 'en' in Nordhaus|en. Whole words get little. Pushes toward word-continuation fragments.

L14n3017.name: Pre-head noun slot word
L14n3017.description: Fires (negative) on the word filling the slot right before the noun it modifies or names: 'official' in 'official pip website', 'settlement' in 'settlement of Jamestown', 'water' in 'provide water', 'health' in 'skin health', 'package' in 'install package-name'. Pushes toward adjective-ending fragments like 'ellij', 'ancial', 'ique'.

L12n623.name: Diffuse web-prose word
L12n623.description: Diffuse and mild: fires on content words mid-sentence in web prose that are followed by an elaboration or list, e.g. 'is' in 'the body is part way out', 'Cultural' in 'Prairie Acadian Cultural Center', 'language' in 'open-source programming language'. Pushes toward dashes, ellipses and asterisks.

L24n1478.name: mis- word-start
L24n1478.description: Fires on 'mis' that opens a word (mischievous, misinformed, misfortune, misfits, misperceptions), peaking on that 'mis' piece and on the 'per' after it in misperceptions; weaker on 'to' after 'ability'. Pushes toward 'recognition' and 'recognize', and steering spams 'recognition'.

L24n2382.name: Problem and conflict words
L24n2382.description: Fires on words for a problem or conflict, peaking on 'problem' before 'solving' and on 'conflict' in 'conflict management', with weaker firing on puzzles, mystery, complaints and confusion. Pushes toward 'resolution', 'resolve' and 'resolved', and steering spams 'resolution'.

L14n2258.name: Grammar-example clause word
L14n2258.description: Diffuse: fires on an auxiliary, modal, possessive or verb-slot word inside example sentences and grammar exercises, e.g. 's' in 'Jessica's failure', 'must' in 'a robot must', 'you' in 'as you requested', 'to' in 'you (to do)'. Pushes toward unrelated word fragments like 'carbonate' and 'qualia'.

L22n492.name: Table field label cells
L22n492.description: Fires (negative) on the label cell of a table header or field name, e.g. 'Address' in '|Address|:', 'Rank', 'Owner', 'Presenter', 'Location' in wiki-style tables, and on the ';' that ends a code statement. Its output weights promote nothing legible, so only the reading is clear.

L24n2416.name: Job and hiring nouns
L24n2416.description: Fires (negative) on the word 'job' and related hiring nouns such as intern, admissions, immigration and asylum, peaking on 'job' in phrases like 'job application', 'job market', 'job posting' and 'job interview'. Pushes toward 'candidate' and 'applicant', and steering spams 'candidates'.

L24n114.name: Token before closing paren
L24n114.description: Fires on the final word, unit or abbreviation just before a closing parenthesis, peaking on 'm' in '(1.2 m)', 'oz' in '(14.5 oz)', 'months' in '(4 months)', 'ol' in '(alpha-tocopherol)' and 'ce' in '(... BCE)', and near zero on the parenthesis itself. Pushes toward closing parentheses and closing quotes, and steering spams them.

L24n2887.name: Inside URLs and filenames
L24n2887.description: Fires on a mid-word piece of a URL, filename or hyphenated slug, peaking on 'ip' in get-pip.py, 'afety' in cyber-safety, 'fund' in superfund and 'aspx' or 'html' in page names, and on ']' in shell prompts; weak on plain prose. Pushes toward '#' and steering spams it.

L24n2406.name: Hex zero and word-starts
L24n2406.description: Mixed: fires (negative) on the '0' of a hex literal right before its 'x' ('P0 = 0xA4', peak on the 0), and on short word-opening pieces such as 'Hum' in humane, 'Rad' in Radley, 'ac' in racism and 'Rob'. Pushes toward 'x', the hex prefix, and steering spams it.

L0n1967.name: Specific word-piece tokens
L0n1967.description: Early-layer, token-identity neuron, negative on specific word pieces with no shared context: 'actors' in tractors, 'ite' in Amorite, 'oth' in tooth, 'itt' in Howitt, 'rail' in railroads, 'ons' in axons, and 'Lord' after 'the'. Pushes toward names like 'Charles' and 'Richard' and toward 'List'.

L20n1662.name: German compound word pieces
L20n1662.description: Fires (negative) on inner subword pieces of German compound words and German place or person names: 'und' in Innbund, 'ere' in Osterei, 'Ost' in Osterbaum, 'ung' and 'zug' in Sommertagszug, 'tt' in Brunsbüttel. Pushes toward short 'ss' and 'sh' fragments.

L23n1079.name: Digit before percent sign
L23n1079.description: Fires on the last digit of a number directly before '%' or 'percent' (the '0' in '10%', the '5' in '26.5%'), with weaker firing on the '%' itself; pushes the model toward writing '%'.

L24n1867.name: Determiner after work verb
L24n1867.description: Fires on a possessive or article right after a verb of doing (carry out their, perform the, finish their, doing their), where a task or job noun comes next; pushes toward 'responsibility', 'job' and 'task'.

L24n1767.name: Advice verb expecting frequency
L24n1767.description: Fires on the main verb of an advice or how-to sentence after 'should' or a subject (should receive, conducts, perform, sends out, reviewed), where a frequency word like 'annually' or 'monthly' usually follows; pushes toward 'regular', 'monthly' and 'annual'.

L24n1088.name: Word before domain
L24n1088.description: Fires on 'its' or 'the' and on word-start pieces (cot-, Co-, orig-) inside cotangent and tangent text about domain, range and asymptotes, e.g. 'based on its vertical asymptotes'; pushes toward 'domain'.

L24n2355.name: Word after UI action
L24n2355.description: Fires on the word right after a software UI action or button name in step-by-step instructions ('click', 'Change button to', 'Auto' in AutoCAD, 'double-click', a bullet dash before a menu action); pushes toward 'save'.

L23n1848.name: Template slot, year digits
L23n1848.description: Fires on the token that opens a fill-in slot in letters, emails and press releases ('Dear' before '[Name]', ':' after 'Mission Statement'), and on digits inside years such as 1961 or 2002; pushes toward the placeholder 'X'.

L20n736.name: Code opener, data nouns
L20n736.description: Fires on 'Here' opening a code answer ('Here is a Java program') and on data-structure nouns in coding requests (array, list, Set, stack, node), weakly elsewhere; pushes toward '<' type or tag starts (<T, <N), with little visible effect.

L24n2044.name: Word before page
L24n2044.description: Fires on 'HTML' or 'web' right before an expected 'page' in web and HTML text ('one HTML page', 'web page'), with noisier firing on capitalised word-starts like 'Bo' and 'Pl'; pushes toward 'page'.

L22n1813.name: Word after takes/accepts
L22n1813.description: Fires on the word right after 'takes' or 'accepts' in function specs ('takes one parameter', 'takes as input', 'accepts a list'), and on 'optional' and 'chars'; pushes toward 'parameter' (or 'param').

L23n2276.name: Later subword piece
L23n2276.description: Fires on a second or later subword piece of a word split into tokens, e.g. 'ECC' in ECC-000, 'oste' in osteoporosis, 'athy' in hypoparathyroidism, 'ry' in Phrynosoma; pushes toward '::' scope tokens and C++-like junk.

L24n1469.name: Adjective before trait noun
L24n1469.description: Fires on the word right before an expected trait noun (desirable, categorical, same, physical, 'of' in 'set of') and on some mid-word fragments (Car-th-age, carp-els); pushes toward 'attributes' and 'characteristic' with a weak effect.

L24n693.name: Time span before earlier/later
L24n693.description: Fires on a time-span word (year, decades, minutes, month, millennium, quarter) that sets up a comparison, e.g. 'one year later', 'ten years earlier', 'a month before'; pushes toward 'early', 'late' and 'later'.

L22n1826.name: 'file' as file input
L22n1826.description: Fires on the word 'file' when it names something read, uploaded or saved in code and how-to text ('CSV file', 'text file', 'upload a file', 'JSON file'); pushes toward 'path' and 'paths'.

L19n2261.name: Middle piece of name
L19n2261.description: Fires on a middle subword piece of a proper noun or foreign name split into tokens (on in Sa|on|dar, ur in Dv|ur Kralove, am in Ya|am|azaki, ri in M|ri|ya); pushes toward short syllable fragments, giving gibberish.

L23n626.name: Word before data type
L23n626.description: Fires on 'of', 'a', ':' and 'as' right before an expected data-type word in code specs ('list of integers', 'data type: String', 'such as character strings'); pushes toward 'string' and 'strings'.

L24n2670.name: Hardware binary, register
L24n2670.description: Fires on hardware-coding words (binary, Receive, Transmit, bus, decimal) and on port writes like 'P0 = 0xFF', plus some mid-name fragments (Rom|mel, Char|alambos); pushes toward 'register' and 'registers' with a strong 'register' effect.

L22n3049.name: Word before copy
L22n3049.description: Fires on the word just before an expected 'copy' or 'copies' in text about getting or printing copies ('hard copy', 'print your own copies', 'bought an old copy', 'extra copies'); pushes toward 'copy'.

L23n2507.name: Word before range
L23n2507.description: Fires on the word right before an expected 'range' in measurement or spread text ('wide wavelength range', 'within the target range', 'can range from', 'visible range'), also on 'temperature' and '%' in value contexts; pushes toward 'range'.

L24n1015.name: Word before supply/demand
L24n1015.description: Fires on market and economics words right before an expected 'supply' or 'demand' ('housing', 'market', 'lack of', 'under-', 'over-', 'store of', 'economies of'); pushes toward 'supply' and 'demand'.

L23n1026.name: Mid-word subword fragment
L23n1026.description: Fires on a subword fragment in the middle of a longer word split into tokens (ak in Yogy|ak|arta, akh in Nak|hon, gl in glaze, Fl in Flank, re in Kre|mer), and on some year and section digits; pushes toward 'get' with little visible effect.

L23n364.name: Code-spec return predictor
L23n364.description: Fires on the 'and' or 'should' in coding-task prompts that sets up the output clause ('takes two strings [and] concatenates', 'function [should] return'), and on 'returns' itself; pushes the model toward writing 'return'.

L21n741.name: Month after date preposition
L21n741.description: Fires on the temporal word just before a date: 'until' in 'until July', 'by' in 'by 2025', 'since', 'from', 'on October 26', 'in' before a year, and 'Born'/'posted'/'published'; pushes the model to write a month name.

L23n1237.name: Metric unit before squared
L23n1237.description: Fires on a metric length unit right before a superscript ² ('km' in 'km²', 'cm' in 'calories/cm²', 'mm' in 'mm²', 'kilometres') and on 'perfect' in 'perfect square'; pushes toward 'square'.

L24n1550.name: Proper-name first fragments
L24n1550.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalized name split across tokens ('Am' in Amherst, 'Vas' in Vasilis, 'Gav' in Gavin, 'Chem' in Chemical Society, 'National' in National Science Foundation); pushes toward 'System'/'system'.

L22n1222.name: Grid-arrangement words; writes 'row'
L22n1222.description: Fires on words that describe how items sit in a line or grid ('along' and 'the' before 'diagonal', 'horizontal', 'adjacent', 'each' before 'side', 'in' before 'lines'); pushes toward 'row'/'rows'.

L22n1913.name: Field-name tokens; writes 'id'
L22n1913.description: Fires on the name of a data field, key or URL parameter where 'ID' is likely to follow ('News' in '?NewsID=', 'employee' in 'employee_id', 'category', 'manager', the '(' before 'ID'); pushes toward 'id'/'ID' tokens.

L22n2615.name: Mid-word fragments and 'check'
L22n2615.description: Fires on the middle piece of a word split into tokens ('ark' in Kh|ark|iv, 'ak' in Ch|ak|ma) and on 'check', 'worth', 'without' in phrases like 'go check it out', 'worth it', 'Rebel without'; pushes toward 'return'/'back'.

L18n569.name: Scattered mid-word fragments
L18n569.description: Fires on arbitrary inner pieces of brand names, foreign names and codes split into tokens (Alka|-S|eltzer, Hotam|is|ligil, Mail|Ch|imp, ECC-2|00, E. coli 0157|:H|7) with no shared meaning; pushes toward junk fragments and whitespace.

L20n747.name: Variable names before '='
L20n747.description: Fires on a single-letter or short variable or field name in math and code ('t' in 'from t', 'n' in 'n = 128', 'y' in 'given y', 'x' in 'f(x)', 'Name', 'Type', 'offset' in offset_value); pushes toward '=' followed by a capital variable letter.

L0n1301.name: Rare-word middle pieces
L0n1301.description: Fires on the later pieces of long or rare words split into several tokens (Blu|-ray, per|ished, Gen|ocide, in|quiring, Em|phas|ize, In|uit); pushes toward generic connectives and newlines.

L24n2560.name: Breakage context; writes 'failure'
L24n2560.description: Goes negative on the word just before a damage or failure term in engineering text ('susceptible [to]' breakage, 'cause them [to] trip', 'safeguard them [against]', 'without [breaking]', 'when they [fail]', 'the [fuse]'); pushes toward 'failure'.

L24n2579.name: Head nouns; writes 'handle'
L24n2579.description: Fires on the noun right after 'a', 'your' or an adjective ('a [feel]', 'your [love]', 'sorted seekable [file]', 'Diffraction [Gr]ating', 'the [function]' in MATLAB code); pushes toward 'handle' or 'hound'.

L24n926.name: Trig names; writes sin/cos
L24n926.description: Fires in trigonometry text on the 'cot' and 'angent' pieces, 'tangent', 'cosine', and on 'of' in 'quotient of cosine'; pushes toward sin, cos and tan.

L23n2602.name: Office-title 'of'; colons
L23n2602.description: Fires on 'of' after an office or organization title ('Department [of]', 'Secretary [of]', 'Minister [of]', 'Dictionary [of]') and on section headers like 'Related'; pushes toward colon tokens such as ':' and ':c'.

L24n808.name: Code-spec 'use'; writes DOM
L24n808.description: Fires on 'use' or 'using' right after 'should' or 'with' in coding instructions ('should [use] regular expressions', 'valid URL [using]'), and on name fragments inside Scandinavian and Indian names (Hø|iv|ik, Vas|udeva); pushes toward 'document', 'window', 'location'.

L23n2341.name: Split-name middles; writes '()'
L23n2341.description: Fires on a middle or late piece of a split proper name or word (Woz|ni|ak, Zeld|ovich, Prze|wal|ski, Mű|h|ely, kri|ya); pushes toward '()' function-call parentheses.

L24n535.name: Input 'and'; writes 'split'
L24n535.description: Fires on the 'and' or comma that closes an input description in coding tasks ('takes a string as an argument [and]', 'separated by spaces[,]', 'reads a text file[,]'), just before the action verb; pushes toward 'split'.

L23n1084.name: IT/software terms; writes 'log'
L23n1084.description: Fires on software and IT-admin words (error in 'error cases', Access in 'Restrict server access', console, read, Chrome, Apache, VPN, alerts) and on 'should' or 'also' in such specs; pushes toward 'log' and 'logging'.

L24n256.name: Latin-name middles; writes '{'
L24n256.description: Fires on middle pieces of Latin and scientific names split into tokens (Di|apt|om|us, X|yle|borus, Ps|oph|odes, Sticher|us bre|vitomentosus), and on digits inside dollar amounts; pushes toward '{' brace tokens.

L24n1298.name: Post-noun 'that'; writes 'value'
L24n1298.description: Fires on the word right after a system, belief or society noun in argument prose ('value system [that]', 'international system [that]', 'creation myth [that]', 'cultures', 'society', 'continues [to]'); pushes toward 'value' or 'values'.

L23n353.name: Closing punctuation before newline
L23n353.description: Closing or sentence-final punctuation (. , : ] ) and closing quotes) right before a line break, e.g. 'lizard.⏎', 'said,⏎', 'Ltd.⏎'; also the '[' opening a bracketed tag. Pushes toward closing code delimiters such as '))' and "')".

L22n1760.name: Relational nouns before 'between'
L22n1760.description: The noun 'relationship' itself (also 'correlation', 'link', 'connection', 'tensions') when it heads a phrase that will take 'between X and Y' next. Pushes the model to write 'between'.

L24n2667.name: Closed-form solution vocabulary
L24n2667.description: Words that name an exact or closed-form answer in math, on the word itself: 'found' in 'can be found by quadrature', 'solved', 'explicit', 'definite', 'exact', 'Find'. Pushes toward 'closed' and 'analytical'.

L21n1335.name: Passive 'by', 'by default'
L21n1335.description: The preposition 'by' right after a passive participle or adjective ('available by default', 'stored by Google', 'swapped by crossing', 'named by'), strongest in 'by default'. Pushes toward 'by' and 'default'.

L23n1463.name: Verb before 'true/false'
L23n1463.description: The verb or copula just before a truth-value word: 'come' in 'come true', 'return', 'is' or 'be' before 'true', 'and' in 'true and false', 'is' before 'accurate'. Pushes toward 'true' and 'false'.

L22n904.name: Estimates and rough figures
L22n904.description: The word just before an estimate or rough figure: 'rough' in 'rough calculation', 'to' in 'difficult to calibrate', 'Hard to say' or 'According to', 'approximately', and cost or $ figures. Pushes toward 'estimate', 'estimation' and 'calculate'.

L24n2714.name: 'rec' fragments, 'receive'
L24n2714.description: Word-start fragments 'rec', 'Rec' and 're-' split off a longer word (recaptured, re-leasing, recollections), and the 'and' in 'send and' just before 'receive'. Pushes toward 'receive', 'received' and 'receiving'.

L21n110.name: Leading digit of years
L21n110.description: The first digit of a year or century: the '2' in 'the 20th century' or '2012', the '1' in '1980s', the '9' in '1990s'. Strongest on the first digit after 'in', 'during the' or 'the'; later digits are weak. Pushes toward digit tokens (0, 4, 9, 7).

L19n2973.name: Line break after title
L19n2973.description: The newline, or the '?', ')' or '.' just before it, that ends a short title, heading or metadata line: 'Written by⏎', 'Vol: 21, No: 21⏎', 'Article number: 645 (2019)⏎', 'Marketing?⏎'. No clear output vocabulary; the dose pushes it into whitespace runs.

L22n2178.name: Formal proof vocabulary
L22n2178.description: Words in a formal-proof or rigorous-argument context: 'formally', 'logical' argument, 'to prove a point', 'the proof,', 'demonstration'. Peak is usually the word right before or after 'proof'. Pushes toward 'proof' and 'prove'.

L22n2106.name: Dictionary and definition contexts
L22n2106.description: Dictionary names ('Dictionary', 'OED') and the copula or 'and' right before a definition ('A safe working load is the maximum...', 'Define and explain'). Pushes toward 'definition', 'define' and 'defined'.

L22n1834.name: Start-point words
L22n1834.description: Words that open a start point in time or a process: the last digit of 'From 1890 onwards', 'now' in 'From now on', 'starting in', 'Start harvesting'. Pushes toward 'start', 'starts' and 'begin'.

L21n2321.name: Mid-word 'ur' syllables
L21n2321.description: The 'ur' syllable (or 'Hur', 'Sur', 'mur', 'aur') in the middle of a name or word split into tokens: Hurrians, murals, Surat, Asturias. Pushes toward 'sqrt' and 'square'.

L22n1300.name: Copula 'is' before 'empty'
L22n1300.description: The copula 'is' right after a subject noun in code or spec text: 'the stack is empty', 'if it is a valid URL'. Peak is on 'is' when 'empty' is the likely next word. Pushes toward 'empty'.

L24n683.name: Tech names and fragments
L24n683.description: Tech names and script openers in prompts: 'React' (in 'React Native'), 'Strava' API, 'FADE IN' screenplay openers, and name fragments ('Palm', 'mang'). Pushes toward underscore-led identifiers ('_js', '_axis').

L23n1622.name: Leading '1' of years
L23n1622.description: The leading '1' of a 4-digit year from the 1300s to 1900s ('in 1348', '1580', 'in 1806'), plus a few capitalized name fragments (Pro-culus, Rad-chuk). Pushes toward 'get' and 'getting'.

L24n875.name: Year '1' and 'le/ge'
L24n875.description: The leading '1' of a year from the 1600s to 1900s ('in 1754', 'during the 1600s', 'in 1968'), and word-start 'le', 'ge', 'Le', 'Ge' fragments (lethal, geothermal, Levy, Gary). Pushes toward 'q'-initial tokens (quad, qh, qq).

L23n584.name: Comparison pivot word
L23n584.description: The word that opens the second term of a comparison: 'like' (just like), 'similar to', 'than a', 'as' in 'the same ... as', 'unlike', 'compared to', and the 'a' right after 'than' or 'to'. Pushes toward 'regular' and 'normal'.

L24n1728.name: Design-pattern list joiners
L24n1728.description: Software-design terms in lists: the comma or 'or' inside a list of patterns or types ('Factory, Builder,', 'Class or Type'), plus 'Data Mapper' and 'Consumer/Event' terms, and name fragments (Mag-, sar-). Pushes toward 'interface'.

L22n397.name: Word before possessive 's
L22n397.description: The noun, adverb or name right before an apostrophe-s possessive: 'today' ('today's wars'), 'country's', 'nation's', 'world's', 'Gym's', 'here's'. Pushes toward the 's' token.
